title: Hometown — low band (~5.0)
notes: Short answers, frequent grammar slips, limited range. Human labels ~5.0.

turns.text: My hometown is small city. I live there many year.
What do you like about it?
I like park. And food is good. People nice.
Yes, more building. Before is quiet, now is noisy. I not like too much car.

fc.comment: Can keep going but answers are short and loosely linked.
evidence: I like park. And food is good.

lr.comment: Basic vocabulary; repetition of simple adjectives.

gra.comment: Frequent article/tense errors; mostly simple clauses.

p.comment: Text-only fixture; pronunciation inferred as intelligible with L1 influence.

items.correction: My hometown is a small city.
items.why: Singular countable nouns need an article.
model: My hometown is a small city near the coast.

highlights.quote: Before is quiet, now is noisy.
highlights.note: Attempts a simple contrast despite form errors.
